description: This Java class 'JsonToBson' provides methods to convert JSON values into BSON representations, including handling various data types such as null, boolean, string, number, array, and object. It implements a visitor interface for processing JSON structures and generating corresponding BSON objects, used in serialization or database storage contexts.

classes.name: JsonToBson
classes.description: A final class that converts JSON values into BSON format using visitor pattern implementations for different JSON data types.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Public static method that initiates the conversion of a JsonValue to a BsonValue.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Returns the BSON representation of a JSON null value.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its BSON equivalent.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Converts a String value to its BSON String representation.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Converts a JsonNumber to the appropriate BSON numeric type (int, long, or double) based on its value.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Converts a stream of BSON values into a BSON array.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Converts a stream of key-value entries into a BSON document, escaping keys as necessary.
